system.description:
Hardening raw chakra over your body, your body grows thick scales, your skin grays, your eyes become black and golden, you grow large spines on your back. Your strength and endurance is magnified, and you become a tyrant on the battlefield. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

AC increases by +2.

Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.

Jugo Clan Hijutsu you cast with a casting time of Special, reduce the Nature Energy cost of their Amplify effects, by half, min 1.

If you benefiting from the Nature Endurance bonus you have advantage on Strength and Constitution Saving Throws.

If you have the Feral Endurance instinct, hostile creatures cannot reduce your DR or ignore any Resistance you have or treat any immunity you have as resistance.

Amplify: By spending 6 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you can remove concentration from this jutsu, and its duration becomes 1 minute.
